variant_notes.A: open-safe: features known when the line opens. Production default.
variant_notes.B: needs the median OPEN across several books, captured before the bet book moves (the app must record openers itself); historical opens come from different feeds whose open timestamps are not published, so the edge is statistically proven on the holdout but its real-time availability is NOT verified -> forward-test before trusting.
variant_notes.C: late news: needs the confirmed starting QB (first snap) before the books adjust; only actionable on early QB news.
variant_notes.E: explains the open->close move with everything known by kickoff: model gap, last-week result vs the spread (recency), letdown / bounce-back spot, starting-QB change, lead back / lead receiver out (share-weighted). Used to EXPLAIN a move; late news, not a bet by itself.

win_prob.note: P(win) = Phi(stage-1 margin / sigma). sigma 16 (the app constant): pre-holdout log loss picks 16.5, the 2023-25 holdout prefers 16 over 16.5 (see why_line.json); informational, fundamentals-only.

feature_notes.d_*: home minus away of features.py side ratings (o_* offense, d_* defense allowed), mkt = market rating
feature_notes.tier_g5: both FBS, neither Power-5 (SEC, Big Ten, Big 12, ACC, Pac-12, Notre Dame)
feature_notes.x_open_vs_cons: bet book open minus median open across books
feature_notes.tx_open_vs_cons: open total minus median open total
feature_notes.stage2 target: open line - consensus close (points); > 0 = market moves toward HOME (spread) / OVER (totals)
